name: SHVF World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: First contested in an eight-fighter single-elimination tournament at the promotion's own second event, and still held by that tournament's own winner at the close of the promotion's first year.

name: SHVF Super-Middleweight Championship
epitaph: Reserved by the promotion's own rules for fighters 240 pounds and under; no titleholder is recorded in the surviving record.
